### Purpose findings

These are recorded as **purpose findings**, not as removal recommendations (📖 `00-stream-contract.md` § Scope-derivation precondition).

- **Six API projects are unmodified scaffolds.** `smart-analyzer-api`, `smart-monitor-api`, `smart-optimizer-api`, `smart-test-api`, `smart-docs-api` and `smart-docs` each contain exactly the default `WeatherForecast` model and `WeatherForecastController` produced by the project template, plus the default Swagger wiring. No source in any of them names a domain concept.

  All five derivation sources were consulted and none established a purpose: ① no in-file intent marker; ② the entry point starts a web host that serves the template's sample endpoint only; ③ five of the six are in `Diginsight.Tools.sln` and are therefore built, but no deployment descriptor names any of them; ④ configuration is the template default; ⑤ no README, and the solution folder claims only the area. The **project names** suggest intent — analyzer, monitor, optimizer, docs — but a name is not one of the five derivation sources and MUST NOT be used as one.

  Recorded as: **placeholders whose intended purpose exists outside the repository.** Escalate to the owner. Do NOT recommend removal — the scaffold-versus-dead-code distinction is exactly the failure mode `D9` exists to prevent.

- **`smart-docs` is not a member of any solution.** It is on disk but referenced by neither `Diginsight.Tools.sln` nor `Diginsight.Tools.Debug.sln`. This is a fact about its build participation, not evidence of its purpose.

- **The Table Storage sink inside `feed-monitor` is reference sample code.** `feed-monitor` writes to Cosmos DB, Blob Storage and Table Storage. The Table sink has no consumer in this repository and no downstream reader — read shallowly, it presents as dead code and as a removal candidate.

  Derivation ① found the intent marker: it is retained deliberately as a **reference sample** of the Table sink shape, and it is required to keep working. Recorded as: **live sample code, in scope, not a removal candidate.** Any remedy that touches it MUST preserve its behaviour.

  This is the standing regression case for `D9-scope-derivation-first`: derive purpose *before* recommending removal. A stream that proposes deleting this sink has skipped derivation.

### Structural observations

- `src/40.00 Service/` is an empty area folder. It declares an intended area with no components in it.
- `src/Job/Diginsight.Tools.FeedMonitor/` holds a single empty `FeedMonitorBackgroundService.cs` and duplicates the path shape of `src/30.00 Job/Diginsight.Tools.FeedMonitor/`, which is the real component. The empty file is **not** registered as a component. Its origin is not derivable from the repository — escalate.
- `Diginsight.Tools.Debug.sln` loads ~25 projects by relative path from sibling repositories outside this repository root. Those projects are **out of scope**: they are not components of this repository and no dossier or page may describe them.
